expected_output.reasoning: The agent's response covers all key expected elements: (1) It identifies delivery failure since 2026-10-20 with AccessDenied errors, calculates ~13 days of missing logs, and points to the destination bucket policy as the fix location. (2) It explicitly notes IsLogging=true does not mean delivery is happening ("The trail is logging, but nothing has reached the destination bucket"). (3) It confirms main-trail logs management events with no readOnly exclusion (M1 check: "Management selector has no readOnly condition"). (4) It correctly identifies finance-reports as covered but with the service-event exclusion caveat, labeling it "Covered (excludes service-initiated events)" rather than plainly covered, and explicitly states replication, lifecycle, Backup and similar service activity has no record. (5) hr-archive is correctly marked Uncovered with no data event record. (6) The response explains automated system attribution via userIdentity.invokedBy, sessionIssuer under aws-service-role, and eventType AwsServiceEvent (N2 note). (7) It notes the exclusion fields apply to data events (the finding is scoped to the "S3 finance data" data selector, distinguishing it from the Management selector which has no such exclusion). (8) Account 444455556666 is taken from supplied ARN and clearly labeled as such. (9) Results are explicitly labeled "Data source: SUPPLIED DATA." (10) No Lambda/DynamoDB coverage invented - explicitly marked NotApplicable/none supplied. (11) No changes are made; next steps are offered as recommendations only, consistent with the no-change requirement. All major criteria are substantively met.

assertion_results.text: The response states that log delivery for main-trail is failing with an S3 access error, that the last successful delivery was 2026-10-20, that roughly 13 days of logs have not been delivered as of 2026-11-02, and that the destination bucket policy (or bucket access) is where the fix lies.
assertion_results.evidence: 'The last delivery was 2026-10-20T03:10:00Z, about 13 days before the supplied date.' and 'The destination bucket policy is the usual cause of AccessDenied on both log and digest delivery.'
assertion_results.reasoning: The response explicitly states delivery failing with AccessDenied, last delivery 2026-10-20, ~13 days gap, and that the fix is the destination bucket policy.

assertion_results.text: The response states that IsLogging being true does not mean logs are arriving in the bucket.
assertion_results.evidence: 'The trail is logging, but nothing has reached the destination bucket since about 2026-10-20T03:10Z.' and 'Delivery to the destination bucket is failing, so the finance-reports record is not currently reaching storage.'
assertion_results.reasoning: The response notes that IsLogging true doesn't mean logs reached the bucket.

assertion_results.text: The response reports finance-reports as having its S3 data events recorded by main-trail but with the narrowing that AWS service originated events and service linked role sessions are excluded by the data selector's eventType and userIdentity.arn conditions; it does not report finance-reports as plainly or fully covered.

assertion_results.evidence: 'The "S3 finance data" selector excludes this activity, so replication, lifecycle, Backup and similar service activity on finance-reports has no record in main-trail.' and M3 finding: 'Remove these field selectors to record AWS service activity, or record that the audit accepts the exclusion'
